name: Azure Cosmos DB
label: Azure Cosmos DB — NoSQL REST
description: Azure Cosmos DB — NoSQL REST. Handler: OfficialApiNode. Official paths GET/POST https://{account}.documents.azure.com/dbs/{db}/colls/{coll}/docs[/{id}]. item.query sends Content-Type application/query+json and x-ms-documentdb-isquery: True; partition_key becomes x-ms-documentdb-partitionkey. Sends x-ms-version: 2018-12-31 (latest listed data-plane REST version) and x-ms-date: RFC 1123 via extraHeaders (https://learn.microsoft.com/en-us/rest/api/cosmos-db/). AAD/RBAC is not supported: official AAD Authorization is type=aad&ver=1.0&sig={token} (URL-encoded), not Bearer — this node still sends Bearer. Docs: https://learn.microsoft.com/en-us/rest/api/cosmos-db/common-cosmosdb-rest-request-headers. Customer owns the database. Minimize payload. Secrets never logged or returned. Errors raise a BPMN error for the error boundary event (INVALID_INPUT, AUTH_FAILED, RATE_LIMITED, HTTP_<status>, REQUEST_FAILED); secrets are redacted.
author: 5c8b0d45-1d10-4f2e-844c-2318af96b2fa

ports.name: input
ports.description: Per-operation fields. Do not put access_token here. Example: {"operation":"item.get"}.

schema.label: operation
schema.description: Overrides config. EXACT: item.get | item.create | item.query.

schema.label: partition_key
schema.description: Partition key value of the item, sent as the x-ms-documentdb-partitionkey header. Accepted: a JSON array with one value matching the container partition key path. Required by item.get and item.create on partitioned containers; optional for item.query (scopes the query to one partition). Blank omits the header. Example: ["ada"].

schema.label: document
schema.description: Item JSON sent as the whole request body for item.create (POST /dbs/{db}/colls/{coll}/docs). Must contain a string `id` (max 255 chars) and the partition key property. Example: {"id":"order-100","pk":"ada","total":42}.

schema.label: query
schema.description: SQL query text for item.query. Example: SELECT * FROM c WHERE c.pk = @pk.

schema.label: parameters
schema.description: Official query parameters [{name, value}] for item.query. Example: [{"name":"@pk","value":"ada"}].

ports.name: output
ports.description: Success: status=ok, http_status, data. Errors raise a BPMN error for the error boundary event (INVALID_INPUT, AUTH_FAILED, RATE_LIMITED, HTTP_<status>, REQUEST_FAILED); secrets are redacted.

schema.label: data
schema.description: Provider JSON body. Secrets never copied here.

configurationParameters.label: Operation
configurationParameters.description: Default operation when input.operation is blank. EXACT: item.get | item.create | item.query.

configurationParameters.label: Access Token
configurationParameters.description: Azure AD access token (secret). Official REST Authorization is type=aad&ver=1.0&sig={token} (URL-encoded; https://learn.microsoft.com/en-us/azure/cosmos-db/how-to-setup-rbac). OfficialApiNode sends Authorization: Bearer. Master-key HMAC is not supported.

configurationParameters.label: Account
configurationParameters.description: Cosmos DB account name substituted into the endpoint host https://{account}.documents.azure.com. Accepted: the account name only, without scheme or domain. Example: contoso-orders.

configurationParameters.label: Partition Key
configurationParameters.description: Partition key value of the item, sent as the x-ms-documentdb-partitionkey header. Accepted: a JSON array with one value matching the container partition key path. Required by item.get and item.create on partitioned containers; optional for item.query (scopes the query to one partition). Blank omits the header. Example: ["ada"].

configurationParameters.label: Document
configurationParameters.description: Item JSON sent as the whole request body for item.create (POST /dbs/{db}/colls/{coll}/docs). Must contain a string `id` (max 255 chars) and the partition key property. Example: {"id":"order-100","pk":"ada","total":42}.

configurationParameters.label: Parameters
configurationParameters.description: Official query parameters [{name, value}] for item.query. Example: [{"name":"@pk","value":"ada"}].

configurationParameters.label: Query
configurationParameters.description: SQL query text for item.query. Example: SELECT * FROM c WHERE c.pk = @pk.
